title: Connectome-based modelling links trauma-predictive brain networks to acute stress response
summary: Connectome-based predictive modelling predicted past trauma exposure from functional connectivity in 170 adults. The trauma-predictive network was attenuated after an acute stress task in a subsample of 92 participants and under hydrocortisone versus placebo in an independent crossover study of 27. The method is a linear-regression-based approach and the samples are modest.

evidence.tested: Prediction of past trauma exposure from connectivity, and network response to acute stress (n = 92) and hydrocortisone (n = 27).
evidence.unknown: Modest sample sizes; causal and clinical meaning not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Connectome-based predictive model of trauma exposure from functional brain connectivity.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI; affiliations from Europe PMC or Crossref where stated. Publisher full text not accessed.
